name: primeshow
description: PrimeShow Full-Stack Cinema Ticket Booking Platform (MERN Stack)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true})"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
